## Projects

__Project 1__: [Sheet Music Database](/Full_Stack/sheet_music_db.qmd)

As a musician, I have a lot of sheet music in a variety of different places. I created this database to help keep track of and organize all of my music. I have two versions, one in MySQL and the other in SQL Server.
